en.name: Grok Enhance
en.description: Grok harness: execution discipline plus first-turn Grep/Glob (and peer tools) without ToolSearch.
en.safetyNotes: Requests agent.extension (unsandboxed sidecar, same trust as the agent). Does not write skills or profile files. When installed it owns before_agent_start and inlines cn.star.user-profile injection so both blocks survive.
